heard: This fish was supposed to be extinct for 66 million years. On December 22, 1938, dedicated museum curator Marjorie Curtnail-Adamer spotted an unfamiliar bright blue fin resting inside a South African fishing catch. Instead of a traditional bony backbone, this remarkable living animal actually possesses a pressurized, oil-filled tube called a notochord. Recent marine biology research reveals these deep sea survivors endure a staggering five-year pregnancy before finally giving birth to live pups. Biologists found this swimming ghost is actually much more closely related to land animals than to 99% of other fish. Scientists had officially declared this prehistoric creature extinct for 66 million years.
differences: 'courtenay latimer' heard as 'curtnail adamer' after 'museum curator marjorie'
